verdict.rationale: GitLab documents an official CLI (glab) at docs.gitlab.com/editor_extensions/gitlab_cli/ and separately provides a REST API for programmatic interaction, but the evidence pack lacks detail on AI-native features within the CLI itself (e.g., agentic workflows, Duo integration via CLI) beyond its existence. Missing for 10: documentation of AI-specific CLI commands/workflows, independent hands-on validation of the CLI's AI-native capabilities, and detail on how it integrates with GitLab Duo agents.
